_readme: Settings for provisioning/dataverse/ensure-auditing.ps1 -Env dev ONLY — deliberately NOT
named dev-settings.json, for the same reason dev-schema-settings.json and
dev-scoring-settings.json are not: Get-ProvisioningSettings -Env dev MUST keep throwing
'file not found'. ProvisioningCommon.Tests.ps1 asserts that throw by name, and several
it as the signal that DEV has nothing of that kind scripted against it in Phase 1.
ensure-auditing.ps1 reads THIS file directly on -Env dev, bypassing
Get-ProvisioningSettings entirely, so that invariant is undisturbed.
NEW 2026-08-22 — improvement review 8, item 3 (IMP-0178). Until now NO DEV settings file
declared dataverse.auditing at all, so `ensure-auditing.ps1 -Env dev` had never had a
runnable path even though its own parameter block accepts 'dev'. That is why the first five
tables were switched on by hand in the admin centre, and why the sixth (rev_review) shipped
with no audit trail and blocked a test cycle.
Review 8's item 3 as written said to add the key to 'a DEV settings file' so the script
becomes runnable. Taken literally that meant creating dev-settings.json, which would have
broken the asserted throw above. This file is the same intent applied through the pattern
Identifiers only — never a secret, token or connection string (C-TECH-001). The provisioning
app id and certificate thumbprint stay in the environment variables named under 'auth'.

dataverse._comment_environmentUrl: Environment REV-GrantApplications-DEV. Same values as dev-schema-settings.json, which is the file ensure-schema.ps1 reads.

auditing._comment: 6 years = 2192 days (C-DOM-010, C-DOM-011, TAD §6.5), matching test-settings.json and prd-settings.json exactly — a shorter DEV retention would make DEV a weaker test of the retention behaviour than the environments it is meant to de-risk.
auditing._comment_auditedTables: Every table under src/solutions/*/Entities/ must appear here — asserted by scripts/verify-audited-tables.py (build gate `audited-tables`). Table-level auditing is entity METADATA: no solution import sets it and none clears it (IMP-0086), so it is set once per table per environment and a table absent from this list is a table nobody switches on.
